name: Slack
description: Post messages and read conversations across the authenticated user's Slack workspace.
_authNote: OAuth endpoints, scopes, client secret ref and any identity step are PLATFORM-OWNED — they live in the private clarity-api (integrations-v2/config/oauth-configs.ts), never in this public repo. This manifest only declares that the integration uses oauth2 and which tools it provides.

providedTools.description: Post a message to a channel. To post a LIST of records, bind `report.rows` to the structured data and it is delivered as an aligned table with a chart — do not flatten a list into prose.

_localNote: Studio can broker this. Only tools marked "local": true can be called — the rest are hosted-platform only.
